Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed today in Court by the State is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
No one appears on behalf of the complainant despite service of notice.

3. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.173 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376,
504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Matera, District Bahraich.

sentences.text: 1 4. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was taken away by the applicant.
It was also alleged that she used to talk over for some period of time.
It was also stated that when the matter was taken up with the parents of the applicant, he left the victim at Bahraich.

In the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., the victim admitted that they used to talk over for 2-3 months and on 12.08.2023, the applicant called her and wanted to marry her and they went to Bahrach, where, the father of the applicant called and thereafter, the applicant left the victim at Bahraich.
A similar statement was given by the victim before the medical authorities.
The medical report on record does not indicate any sign of sexual assault.
In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., there is a slight variance alleging rape being committed on her.

5. In the light of the aforesaid, the submission of the counsel for the applicant is that apart from the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., there is no allegation of rape and the statement is not corroborated by the medical report on record.

He further argues that as per the school certificate,
the age of the victim is 17 years 4 months.
6. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

7. Considering the said abovesaid submissions and the fact that there is no document, by which, a concrete conclusion can be drawn with regard to the age of the victim at this stage, which is to be seen at the time of trial and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 21.08.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

Accordingly,
the bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Rabi Ahmad be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
